title: Export the list as CSV
goal: People open their items in a spreadsheet, and real titles do not break the file.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /todos.csv answers 200 with Content-Type text/csv; charset=utf-8 and a UTF-8 body without a byte order mark: the header line id,title,done,due_date, then one line per item in id order. Every line, the last one too, ends with CRLF. done is written true or false; an item without a due date has an empty field.
A field that contains a comma, a double quote, a carriage return or a line feed is put in double quotes, and every double quote inside it is doubled. No other field is quoted.
A title that starts with =, +, - or @ gets an apostrophe in front of it, before AC2 is applied, so that a spreadsheet does not run it as a formula.
The export takes the query parameters of GET /todos and answers bad ones the same way. /todos.csv is a route: another method answers 405. README.md lists it.

context.notes: Keep node:http only; no dependencies. Add tests for every acceptance criterion.
